candidates.description: This feature vector represents quantifying words and indefinite adjectives expressing plurality or a nonspecific quantity across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on German verbs, particularly auxiliary and common action verbs in various tenses and conjugations.
This feature vector represents adverbs and adjectives that modify the degree, manner, or timeframe of an action or state.
This feature vector represents adverbial suffixes and adverbs across Romance languages.
This feature vector represents additive adverbs and connectors across multiple European languages, primarily meaning "also," "too," or "furthermore."
This vector represents universal quantification across languages, corresponding to words that mean "every," "all," or "each."
This vector represents abstract mental constructs, terminology, and literary or theoretical works.
This vector represents common French grammatical words and function terms such as conjunctions, prepositions, and auxiliary verbs.
These tokens function as common adverbial modifiers and intensifiers across multiple European languages to qualify scope, negation, or emphasis.
This vector represents past-tense verbs indicating actions, events, or state changes performed on objects or entities.
